title.name: Founder judgment and the prioritisation map

overview.description: Biopunk workshop 2 in the medium case. By week 10 the problem is no longer what to do, it is what to stop.
objectives: Rank company activities by contribution to the next milestone
Say no to good opportunities that are not this quarter’s opportunity
Distinguish evidence from opinion in your own reasoning
prerequisites: Technical risk, market risk and the risk map

steps.intro: Biopunk workshop 2 in the medium case. By week 10 the problem is no longer what to do, it is what to stop.
instructions: List everything the company is currently doing.
Score each against the next funding or customer milestone.
Kill or park the bottom third. Write down what you killed and why — you will be asked.

submission.description: Produce the Company Prioritization Map and log it against this module in Homeroom. Done means the artefact exists, not that you read the page.
